message:
test(event-log): cover the encrypted free text in envelope and acceptance tests

Envelope unit, application, integration and acceptance tests, plus the
evidence-audit acceptance tests, now expect the title, document name,
void reason and reservations as encrypted values in the log.

test(event-log): cover decrypted reads in the trail and receipt

Evidence-audit and foundation tests check that the trail and the receipt
decrypt each member by its own table, and that an erased or unreadable
text reads as such.

feat(event-log): encrypt the other free text of the log

ENVELOPE_CREATED.title, DOCUMENT_ADDED_TO_ENVELOPE.name,
ENVELOPE_VOIDED.reason and SIGNATURE_COMMITTED.reservations are now
encrypted at the append, as SESSION_DECLINED.reason already was. Facts
written earlier keep their clear text and still decode. The trail and the
receipt decrypt in the worker. This last part holds the remaining tests.

fix(evidence-audit): print undrawable characters as code points, source contacts from rows

A character the template cannot draw prints as its code point, so no
text stops a trail or a receipt. A code's contact and an invitation's
destination are read from their row, and a sent document's chain starts
at the upload the send pinned.

fix(kernel): an id has one spelling

An upper-case id is accepted and is the same id as its lowercase form on
every route and in every fact. A repeated delegated call in the other
spelling answers 409 SESSION_ALREADY_COMPLETED.

feat(event-log): declare the key uses of identity and act evidence

Adds the key uses for a recipient's identity and for the evidence an act
observed and reported, and names the label and display name among the
sender's text.

feat(session): record an act's evidence in the log

SIGNATURE_COMMITTED and SESSION_DECLINED now hold the observed and
reported values of the act, encrypted, each kind under its own key use.
A delegated commit also holds its asserted values.

test(evidence-audit): fail when a stored payload holds plaintext

Drives thirteen routes and the relay to an ended envelope, then reads the
raw payloads after each route and fails if a protected value appears in
clear.

test(evidence-audit): fail when a document reads an unnamed field

Assembles the trail and the receipt twice from one real run, the second
time with every field the views do not name altered, and expects the
documents to be identical.

test(evidence-audit): compare each new fact member with its input

Each new member is decrypted under its key use and compared with the
route's own input, including the evidence of an act. A census of
documents also classifies its one literal date.

feat(envelope): record the send's snapshot and each party's identity

ENVELOPE_SENT now holds the signing mode, the date and the encrypted
tenant label, and the roster holds how each party is identified.

feat(event-log): record the contact each message used and later document artifacts

The delivery outcome records its contact, encrypted. A new
DOCUMENT_ARTIFACT_RECORDED fact holds each later signature and seal in the
write of that row. ADRs 0049, 0055, 0057, 0072 and 0096 are amended to
match, and the act's clear evidence has tests for each refusal.

fix(notification): record the contact of a refused message and tighten identity facts

A provider's refusal of a party's only channel records
RECIPIENT_DESTINATION_REFUSED with the refused contact. A claimed identity
is recorded only after the send, and the log refuses a fact whose flag and
member disagree.

fix(session): keep a far client date and a failed encode from stopping an act

A client date outside years 1 to 9999 is dropped as OUT_OF_RANGE and the
act goes on. A failed encode no longer carries the payload in its trace.
Adds the stored forms of a declared subject and records the refusal's
fact in the ADRs.

feat(envelope): record the declared subject on a create and a send

POST /api/v1/envelopes and the send route now record
F5Sign-Declared-Subject on ENVELOPE_CREATED and ENVELOPE_SENT. A person's
reference is stored encrypted.

feat(envelope): record the declared subject on void, close, claim and expiry extension

The void, close, claim and expiry-extension routes record
F5Sign-Declared-Subject on their facts, encrypted when it names a person.
ADR-0047, 0055, 0057 and 0096 state the new home, and ADR-0097 the rule.

build(deps): update Symfony, runtime patches and PHPStan

Symfony 7.4 components move to 7.4.17 through 7.4.23 with their contracts
and polyfills. The published text of F5Sign-Declared-Subject now says
which acts record it.

fix(notification): state when a refused message was requested

A refusal in a defeated occasion states when the platform asked for the
message. ENVELOPE_ROSTER_DECLARED now holds what the sender required of
each party, and a User-Agent is recorded only within its rules (UTF-8, no
control character, at most 1,024 characters).

fix(session): compare act evidence whatever its key order

ActEvidenceInClear::equals() now holds a value equal to its decoded copy.
ADR-0097 also states the window of a contact after a close, and the
docblocks of touched files are reworded to stay true over time.

fix(notification): look for the occasion before resolving a channel

A redelivered invitation reaction no longer records a missed invitation
when its occasion already exists. A redelivered SESSION_COMPLETED writes
no second fact for a leg, a verdict is dated by the occasion it ends, and
the --operator help asks for a staff id, never a name.

fix(notification): keep the microseconds of a delivery's instants

requested_at and settled_at keep their microseconds. A refusal fact now
states when the provider settled the delivery, ADR-0097 records what
bounds a verdict's distance from its refusal, and the trail prints a
column with when the platform wrote each fact.

test(notification): replay each route after each pump

Delivers every fact of a route again after each pump and fails on a new
fact. Further tests hold the refusal's settled instant and reference, and
that only a completed leg stops a non-signing role's fact. A refusal to
send no longer ends in an unresolved placeholder.

fix(observability): keep frame arguments out of production traces

Sets zend.exception_ignore_args=On in the production image, with a test
that fails if the setting or the image's copy is missing. An SMS number
and body are marked sensitive, and BL-278 and BL-492 are restated.

Merge develop: release v0.0.3

Encrypts the event log's free text under erasable keyrings, states
refusals, verdicts and delivery instants on their facts, and records the
declared subject.

fix(session): a send or answer on an unclaimed slot answers 409 and writes nothing

The auth context now says whether the recipient is an unclaimed slot. A
machine code send or answer on such a slot answers 409 and writes
nothing, instead of AUTH_NO_DESTINATION after a write or a 401.

fix(session): a delegated commit on an unclaimed slot answers 409

A delegated commit on a claimable MACHINE_KEY slot no longer answers 204
and keeps no session. A census names the slot question on every machine
route, and the published 409 names RECIPIENT_SLOT_NOT_CLAIMED.

test(session): a claimed slot walks the machine routes

A claim lifts the refusal on an unclaimed slot, and a named machine-key
signer is signed with no claim. The published 409 text says where
claiming cannot cure it.

docs(task-078): state what the machine routes do with an unclaimed slot

The handoff and records say which three answers changed and when
RECIPIENT_SLOT_NOT_CLAIMED applies. A test now covers the refusal's
factory itself.

docs(backlog): give the unclaimed slot's rows ids nobody else holds

develop had given two of the ids to other rows, so the slot's rows take
new ones.

chore(qa): run the suite once, and mutate only the changed lines

composer qa runs PHPUnit once under coverage and hands that coverage to
Infection, which mutates only the lines changed against origin/develop.

docs(tests): describe running each story once per test class

Notes the new rule that a story runs once per test class and each test
asks for its record.

test: run each acceptance story once per test class

Adds RunsEachStoryOnce so a story runs once per test class and each test
asks for its record. The acceptance tests that read a story move to it.

test: run each story once per test class for the claims that read it

The envelope, evidence-audit and foundation acceptance tests now share
one run of a story per class. A failed run stays failed for every test
that asks for it.

test: end each race hold on the wait, and lower lock timeouts to 250 ms

The race child holds its locks until another process waits on them or
the parent releases them. A test class also shares no statics with
another test class.

test: run the second process of each race test through one script

Adds tests/bin/second_process.php as the single script for the second
process of a race test.

test: cut waiting and repeated startup in slow tests

One PDF form reader process serves a test class, Typst template queries
skip the page layout, and acceptance tests wait on the clock and the
relay instead of fixed sleeps. The ending bars run under SINGLE_SEAL
except bar (a).

perf(signature-execution): the form engine skips certvalidator's init

Loads the modules of pyhanko-certvalidator without its package
__init__.py, so the form engine no longer loads what it never uses.

refactor(envelope): read the root-lock wait bound from a parameter

The bound is envelope.root_lock_wait_ms: 5000 ms in production and
1000 ms in the test environment.

fix(envelope): refuse a non-string element in a declared list with 422

A non-string element in auth.access_methods or auth.signing_methods
answers 422 naming the element, instead of failing later.

fix(signature-execution): print what the mark font cannot draw

A visible mark prints each character of the signer's name that its font
cannot draw as its code point. Unit tests also claim the guards against
a non-string element in the auth lists.

fix(session): refuse a non-UUID path id on the delegated signature route

A non-UUID envelope or recipient id answers 400 INVALID_ENVELOPE_ID or
INVALID_RECIPIENT_ID on the delegated route.

test: claim the delegated route's path-id guard and tighten two stories

A unit test covers the path-id guard of the delegated route. The
secured-early story records the seal's log position right after A signs,
and checks that a missing closed_at or completed_at now fail.

test: one PHPUnit suite per tier, and a run without acceptance

phpunit.dist.xml declares the suites unit, application, integration and
acceptance by directory, so a run can leave acceptance out.

fix(http): refuse a JSON body that is not an object before mapping

A mapped request body that is a list with items, a string, a number, a
boolean or null answers 400 BAD_REQUEST. A new test helper also bounds a
wait behind a lock the test holds.

fix(http): refuse a NUL in recorded text and bound a signer's name

A NUL in a name, title, reservation or reason is refused, and full_name
above 1,000 characters answers 422. A void after another ending is
refused by name, and one red day no longer keeps the custodian's run
report red.

fix(session): a repeated delegated signature answers 409, not 422

A delegated commit for a recipient already signed answers 409
SESSION_ALREADY_COMPLETED. Two concurrent opens of one signing session no
longer give the second a 500 or a deadlock, and each log record carries
the request id.

fix(messenger): a DSS outage is retried for about three hours

A signing or seal that finds DSS unavailable is retried for about three
hours. The production image no longer names its PHP version, the backend
can refuse a Host it does not serve (SYMFONY_TRUSTED_HOSTS), and a DSS 5xx
carries DSS's own message with no document name.

Merge develop: release v1.0.1

Refuses malformed requests with 400 or 422 instead of 500, retries a DSS
outage for about three hours, and hardens the production image.

build(deps): update the test and QA dependencies

PHPUnit 13.4.7 with php-code-coverage 14.5, and the matching Infection
and sebastian packages.

perf(infection): give mutant processes a read-only OPcache file cache

Adds bin/infection-cached, which fills an OPcache file cache and runs
Infection with that cache read-only for each mutant process.

docs(adr): propose a sealed certificate for each final document

ADR-0094, Proposed. A counterparty asks whether a document was signed, by
whom and how it ended; the receipt answers only for its own recipient,
so a final document gets a sealed certificate for everyone who can see it.

Merge develop into fix/unclaimed-slot-on-machine-routes: bring TASK-078 up to date

Both sides added a parameter to the same helper of
IssueAuthChallengeUseCaseTest; both are kept.

Merge fix/unclaimed-slot-on-machine-routes: TASK-078, machine routes refuse unclaimed slot

The send, the submit and the delegated commit answer 409 on an unclaimed
slot and write nothing.
Merge docs/adr-0094-document-certificate: ADR-0094, a certificate per final document
